theorems.name: Submission.dtc_approxTangent_sdiff_singleton
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (x p : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), MeasurableSet M → x ≠ p → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (M \ {p}) x Q
